params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'MhwUiEvidence\runtime-base'; $game=Join-Path $root 'game'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $game 'nativePC') | Out-Null; $gameExe=Join-Path $game 'MonsterHunterWorld.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path $gameExe)){ [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($gameExe,[byte[]](0..255)) }; $env:MOD_MANAGER_HOME=$root; $env:MOD_MANAGER_GAME_ROOT=$game; $env:MOD_MANAGER_DEBUG_ROOT=$root; $exe=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'MhwUiEvidence\base\src\MhwModManager.App\bin\Release\net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0\MHW Mod Manager.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path $exe)){ throw "Base executable missing: $exe" }; $p=Start-Process -FilePath $exe -WorkingDirectory (Split-Path $exe) -PassThru; Write-Output ('PID='+$p.Id)
